title: List closed work newest-closed first by stored close time
outcome: List closed work newest-closed first by stored close time
acceptance: An opt-in `ls --closed` (MCP `closed: true`) lists every completed, cancelled and superseded item exactly once in ONE list, including items from the 2026-09 historical import, ordered by the stored closed_at descending with the stable work id as tie-breaker; there is no separate section, category or label for imported history.

Closed rows carry the terminal kind and closed_at; the continuation is project-, filter- and order-bound with a (closed_at, work_id) seek key, survives a process restart while the ordered sequence is unchanged, and refuses a mismatched project, filter or order or a changed membership; incompatible ready/blocked switches are refused; the existing 1..1000 limit clamp, 12 KiB page fitting and last-emitted-key anchoring are kept.
The listing is derived at query time from stored records with no schema change or migration, and existing `ls`, `--all`, `--search` and `--ready` outputs and cursor semantics are unchanged.
disposal_reason: Not needed now (Greg, Advisor #1458): the TermAl Closed view uses the existing `ls --all` continuation with client-side lifecycle filtering and Updated sorting; the payload already has lifecycle and updated_at. Revive only if that payload demonstrably lacks the needed fields.
